claims.claim_text: These sustainability-related financial disclosures are prepared to provide information about sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s cash flows, its access to finance or cost of capital over the short, medium or long term (collectively, the entity’s prospects).
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 objective to disclose sustainability-related risks/opportunities affecting cash flows, access to finance, or cost of capital over short/medium/long term.

claims.claim_text: A complete set of sustainability-related financial disclosures presents fairly all sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects.
claims.support_notes: Direct restatement of IFRS S1 paragraph 11 requirement.

claims.claim_text: Fair presentation requires disclosure of relevant information about sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects and faithful representation of that information, including a complete, neutral and accurate depiction.
claims.support_notes: Aligns with IFRS S1 paragraph 13 on relevant information and faithful representation (complete, neutral, accurate).

claims.claim_text: Fair presentation also requires the entity to disclose information that is comparable, verifiable, timely and understandable.
claims.support_notes: Directly corresponds to IFRS S1 paragraph 15(a).

claims.claim_text: Fair presentation also requires the entity to disclose additional information when compliance with specifically applicable IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards is insufficient to enable users to understand the effects of sustainability-related risks and opportunities on cash flows, access to finance and cost of capital over the short, medium and long term.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 15(b) additional information requirement when specific requirements are insufficient.

claims.claim_text: To identify sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects, the entity applies the requirements in paragraphs B1–B12.
claims.support_notes: Direct restatement of IFRS S1 paragraph 12.

claims.claim_text: In identifying sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects, the entity applies IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards.
claims.support_notes: Direct restatement of IFRS S1 paragraph 54.

claims.claim_text: The entity discloses material information about the sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects.
claims.support_notes: Direct restatement of IFRS S1 paragraph 17.

claims.claim_text: To identify and disclose material information, the entity applies the requirements in paragraphs B13–B37.
claims.support_notes: Direct restatement of IFRS S1 paragraph 19.

claims.claim_text: The entity’s sustainability-related financial disclosures are for the same reporting entity as the related financial statements.
claims.support_notes: Direct restatement of IFRS S1 paragraph 20.

claims.claim_text: The entity provides information in a manner that enables users to understand connections between items, including connections between various sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 21(a) on connections between items.

claims.claim_text: The entity provides information enabling users to understand connections between disclosures within its sustainability-related financial disclosures (including governance, strategy, risk management, and metrics and targets).
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 21(b)(i).

claims.claim_text: The entity provides information enabling users to understand connections across its sustainability-related financial disclosures and other general purpose financial reports published by the entity, such as its related financial statements.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 21(b)(ii).

claims.claim_text: The entity identifies the financial statements to which the sustainability-related financial disclosures relate.
claims.support_notes: Direct restatement of IFRS S1 paragraph 22.

claims.claim_text: Data and assumptions used in preparing the sustainability-related financial disclosures are consistent, to the extent possible considering IFRS Accounting Standards or other applicable GAAP, with corresponding data and assumptions used in preparing the related financial statements.
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 23 consistency requirement (to the extent possible).

claims.claim_text: When currency is specified as the unit of measure in the sustainability-related financial disclosures, the entity uses the presentation currency of its related financial statements.
claims.support_notes: Direct restatement of IFRS S1 paragraph 24.

claims.claim_text: Unless another IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard permits or requires otherwise, the entity provides disclosures about governance (processes, controls and procedures to monitor and manage sustainability-related risks and opportunities).
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 25(a) governance core content.

claims.claim_text: Unless another IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard permits or requires otherwise, the entity provides disclosures about strategy (approach to manage sustainability-related risks and opportunities).
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 25(b) strategy core content.

claims.claim_text: Unless another IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard permits or requires otherwise, the entity provides disclosures about risk management (processes to identify, assess, prioritise and monitor sustainability-related risks and opportunities).
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 25(c) risk management core content.

claims.claim_text: Unless another IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard permits or requires otherwise, the entity provides disclosures about metrics and targets (performance and progress towards targets set or required by law or regulation).
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 25(d) metrics and targets core content.

claims.claim_text: In identifying applicable disclosure requirements about a sustainability-related risk or opportunity, the entity applies the IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard that specifically applies to that risk or opportunity.
claims.support_notes: Direct restatement of IFRS S1 paragraph 56.

claims.claim_text: In addition to IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards, the entity refers to and considers the applicability of the disclosure topics in the SASB Standards.
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 55(a) requirement to consider SASB disclosure topics.

claims.claim_text: In the absence of an IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard that specifically applies, the entity applies judgement to identify information that is relevant to users’ decision-making and faithfully represents the sustainability-related risk or opportunity.
entities: users of general purpose financial reports
evidence_sources: draft_markdown:Sources of guidance (absence of standard bullets)
claims.support_notes: Combines IFRS S1 paragraph 57(a) and 57(b) criteria for judgement when no specific standard applies.

claims.claim_text: In making that judgement, the entity refers to and considers the applicability of the metrics associated with the disclosure topics included in the SASB Standards.
claims.support_notes: Matches IFRS S1 paragraph 58(a) requirement to consider SASB metrics when applying judgement.

claims.claim_text: Information required by an IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard may be included in sustainability-related financial disclosures by cross-reference to another report published by the entity, and when cross-referenced the entity applies the requirements in paragraphs B45–B47.
